audit_items.proof_trace: `exchange_rate()` computes its numerator from `self.cash` — an internal tracked counter updated only by `deposit_underlying`, `withdraw_underlying`, and `increase_reserve_only` — never from the actual `Balance<CoinType>` field. In Sui Move, `Balance<T>` is not addressable; coins cannot be transferred to a contract without explicitly calling a function, so no path exists to add to `underlying_balance` without also updating `self.cash`. The exchange rate is therefore structurally immune to donation manipulation.
